source.report: NASA TM 102788 - Carbon dioxide and water exchange rates by a wheat crop in NASA's Biomass Production Chamber
source.authors: R. M. Wheeler and J. C. Sager
source.campaign: Biomass Production Chamber, Kennedy Space Center; wheat (Yecora Rojo) stand, 20 m2, seed to harvest, 86 days, January to April 1989

conventions.value_units: as printed in the report; no unit conversion is applied to the stored value
conventions.page: PDF page number of data/raw/NTRS/19900016137.pdf (the printed page number differs; the report's own numbering starts at page 1 on PDF page 4)
conventions.quote: verbatim text lifted from the PDF text layer of the cited page, with only whitespace collapsed; the scanned report's own spacing and OCR slips are preserved
conventions.reading: the same quantity written in conventional notation, for display only
conventions.kind: reported = stated as a measured or computed result; derived = arithmetic on reported values, with the inputs named
conventions.no_digitisation: figure marker positions were NOT machine-digitised. An extraction attempt was made and rejected: annotation arrows and label glyphs in these scanned plots are the same ink density as the plotted dots, and a candidate run produced a false peak of 38 umol m-2 s-1 (the report states 27) - see docs/PHASE16_BPC_MEASUREMENTS_AND_BENCHMARK.md. Only values stated in the report's own text are recorded here.

derived.quantity: peak net CO2 fixation per unit area

derived.note: peak day (~25) only, held over a 20 h photoperiod
consistent with the report's own 4.5 L m-2 day-1 cycle mean
total harvested biomass (edible + inedible) over the full 86-day stand life; wheat, not a leafy crop

derived.quantity: O2 released at the measured CO2 fixation rate
derived.note: stoichiometric only - the report did not measure O2; the simulator uses the same 32/44 ratio, so this anchor tests the shared assumption, not the crop

limits: One chamber, one cultivar (Yecora Rojo wheat), one campaign; the report itself says the data were not evaluated statistically.
Ground-based closed chamber at ~101 kPa with 1000 ppm CO2 and 20 h photoperiod - not a lunar or Martian environment, and not evidence about reduced gravity.
Edible yield is not the measured quantity: 40 kg is total biomass including straw and roots.
The report's fluxes are whole-stand values including roots and microorganisms, so per-m2 numbers are not directly a leaf-level rate.
